glosses: Faire en sorte que quelque chose ne soit plus sélectionné.

glosses: To cancel a previous selection, especially by removing a mark from a tick box.
To reverse the previous selection of.
To not select; to rule out of selection.

glosses: To reject (an incumbent) as a party's candidate for a forthcoming election.

examples.text: One recently deselected Sinn Féin assembly member, Davy Hyland in Newry and Armagh, has already quit the party in protest.

glosses: To remove from an existing selection.

examples.text: Make sure you deselect any files you wish to keep before proceeding with the deletion.
